goal: Build a state-of-the-art macOS App Store UI for App Store by Agrigence with Discover spotlight, top charts, category filters, interactive search, product pages, and 1-click GET downloads

steps.title: Design and implement App Store CSS styling with macOS glass navigation, store shelves, pill GET buttons, and rating badges
steps.note: Created css/appstore.css featuring complete macOS App Store design system: Discover spotlight cards, Top Charts shelves, pill GET buttons with IAP notes, metrics ribbons, and search inputs

steps.title: Build the App Store storefront on index.html with Discover spotlight, Top Free charts, search filtering, and app cards
steps.note: Completed Step s2: Built App Store storefront on index.html with Discover spotlight, Top Free charts (#1 LiquidDynamo, #2 Agent Guard), interactive search filtering (Cmd+K), and app cards. Verified via HTTP 200 response on http://localhost:3000/ and http://localhost:3000/js/appstore.js.

steps.title: Integrate rich App Store Product Detail pages with metrics ribbons, preview carousels, and What's New version changelogs
steps.note: Completed Step s3: Integrated authentic macOS App Store Product Detail layouts on both dynamo.html and agent-guard.html with app-detail-header, metrics-ribbon (ratings, rank, age, architecture, size), What's New changelog cards, 1-click GET pill buttons, and Information specifications grids. Verified via curl tests on http://localhost:3000/dynamo and http://localhost:3000/agent-guard returning HTTP 200 with all components.

steps.title: Verify App Store UI interactions, search, responsive layout, and push to GitHub repository webstore
